name: aether
description: Private self-hosted media gallery for local photo and video libraries.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @aether/server" "npm run dev -w @aether/web"
scripts.dev:lan: AETHER_HOST=0.0.0.0 AETHER_WEB_HOST=0.0.0.0 AETHER_API_PROXY_HOST=127.0.0.1 npm run dev
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run build
